infobox.usage: Unlocks the easternmost apartment on the second floor of the Chekannaya 15 apartment building on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Chekannaya 15 apartment key (Chek. 15) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the apartments located at Chekannaya 15.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text:
- This is a required location for the quest Debtor
- 1 needs to be obtained for the quest House Arrest

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The easternmost door on the second floor of the Chekannaya 15 apartment building at Streets of Tarkov. Only accessible via the western staircase from the third floor through a hole in the floor of cell #5. The debris in the second floor hallway can only be passed by proning.
